what: B meets Haru, Miwa and Ken and opens the locker at the e1 gate (2, 0): the chapter clears and B's chapter.cleared deed is written

repeat.until: (async()=>{const s=await window.__e2e.state(); const t=await window.__e2e.nextTodo(); return !t || !s.nearby || s.nearby.id!==t.id})()

actions.eval: (async()=>{const S=await import('/state/index.ts'); const H=await import('/history/index.ts'); const p=S.useLandStore.getState().progress; const e=p.episodes.e1; const n=H.worldNow(); const deeds=Object.values(n.events).filter(r=>r.kind==='deed'); return JSON.stringify({ms: Date.now()-window.__e2e.t0, cleared:e.cleared, met:e.stage?.met, found:e.stage?.found, carry:p.storyCarry, head:n.head.n, deeds: deeds.map(d=>({id:d.id, n:d.n, author:d.author, label:d.label, where:d.where, pending:d.pending}))})})()
